crossRefs.note: Then call, and I will answer, or let me speak, and you answer me.
Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!
I would set my cause in order before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.
Brace yourself like a man, for I will question you, then you answer me!
You said, ‘Listen, now, and I will speak; I will question you, and you will answer me.’

translations.web: “Now brace yourself like a man. I will question you, and you will answer me.
translations.bsb: “Now brace yourself like a man; I will question you, and you shall inform Me.
translations.kjv: Gird up thy loins now like a man: I will demand of thee, and declare
translations.asv: Gird up thy loins now like a man: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.
